classification.difficultyReason: Complete scaffolded reciprocal calculations and connect their quotients to groups in the supplied bars, recognising a leftover portion as half a divisor-sized group.

answer.worked: The two wholes contain six thirds. Each group uses two thirds, so $6\div2=3$ groups fit.
The two wholes contain ten fifths. Each group uses two fifths, so $10\div2=5$ groups fit.
Ten fifths contain two full groups of four fifths, with two fifths left. The remainder is half a group, so $2\frac{1}{2}$ groups fit.
Three quarters contain three groups of one quarter.
Each half contains two quarters. Five quarters contain two full halves and one quarter left, so $2\frac{1}{2}$ half-sized groups fit.
